titleTemplate.title: Page title pattern
titleTemplate.description: How product and category page titles are written: {name} is the product or category, {business} your business name.

brandName.title: Name in titles
brandName.description: The name {business} and {storeName} stand for in page titles and descriptions. Empty: your business name.

productTitle.title: Product title
productTitle.description: A product's part of the page title ({name} of the title pattern): {name} is the product, {brand} its brand, {category} its category, {storeName} the name in titles. A product's own SEO title replaces it.

categoryTitle.title: Category title
categoryTitle.description: A category's part of the page title ({name} of the title pattern): {name} is the category, {category} the category above it, {storeName} the name in titles, for example Shop {name}. A category's own SEO title replaces it.

productDescription.title: Product description pattern
productDescription.description: Used when a product has no SEO description of its own, before its summary and description: {name}, {brand}, {category} and {storeName}. Empty: the summary, then the description.

categoryDescription.title: Category description pattern
categoryDescription.description: Used when a category has no SEO description of its own, before its summary and description: {name}, {category} and {storeName}, for example Browse {name} at {storeName}. Empty: the summary, then the description.

gradedCondition.title: Condition of graded items
gradedCondition.description: The condition search engines are told for graded items whose grade names no condition. Items without a grade are new.

pagedListings.title: Listing pages after the first
pagedListings.description: Pages 2, 3 … of a category or landing page: indexed, each with its own address as canonical; or not indexed (noindex, follow), with the first page as canonical.

sitemapUrl.title: Sitemap address
sitemapUrl.description: Where your website serves the sitemap. Above the addresses per sitemap file it becomes an index of files at this address with ?file=categories, ?file=landings, ?file=products-1 …

sitemapSize.title: Addresses per sitemap file
sitemapSize.description: Above this many addresses the sitemap becomes an index of files (categories, landing pages, products-1, products-2 …).

defaultDescription.title: Default description
defaultDescription.description: Used when a page has no description of its own.

defaultImage.title: Default image
defaultImage.description: An https address used when a page has no image of its own.

indexNowOnSave.title: Send changes to IndexNow
indexNowOnSave.description: When a product or category is saved, its address is sent to search engines through Growth's IndexNow (paste the Growth token in Connections).
